## fest v0.9.0

## Release v0.9.0

This stable release includes the following changes.

Summary:
- 9 features
- 2 fixes
- 4 documentation updates
- 4 maintenance changes

Compare: https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/fest/compare/v0.8.2...v0.9.0

## Highlights

- Defer a blocked task, sweep deferred blockers at festival end, force to drop ([#424](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/fest/pull/424))
- Append forced-completion records instead of overwriting DROPPED_BLOCKERS.md
- Make Fest README easier to try and share ([#423](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/fest/pull/423))

## Features

- Defer a blocked task, sweep deferred blockers at festival end, force to drop ([#424](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/fest/pull/424))
- Carry deferred blockers, the sweep and the executor policy into fest next
- Add fest task blocked --list and split the blocker displays
- Bring deferred blockers back, bound the sweep, and guard forced completion
- Add fest task defer and the fest task unblock reject note
- Add the shared operator guard, the typed deferral confirmation and the ledger cross-check
- Convert every progression call site to the settled predicate
- Make deferral, sweep and forced completion durable in the event log
- Add the task deferral record, the settled and done predicates, and fest task blocked --tried

## Fixes

- Append forced-completion records instead of overwriting DROPPED_BLOCKERS.md
- Recognise the CLAUDECODE marker Claude Code actually sets

## Documentation

- Make Fest README easier to try and share ([#423](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/fest/pull/423))
- Restore README banner at a compact size
- Separate Festival suite and Fest CLI installation
- Drop the retired Go Report Card badge ([#422](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/fest/pull/422))

## Maintenance

- Keep the fest watch deferral demo gif and tape, move the evidence bundle out of the repo
- Drop the python bytecode the harness check left behind
- Run the acceptance scenario in the container and prove the watch row is unchanged
- Publish test coverage and report-card links ([#421](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/fest/pull/421))

```
brew tap Obedience-Corp/tap
brew install gaze
gaze list
```

On Linux the user must be in group `video`. From source: `just build && just install`.

**MCP**
```json
{ "mcpServers": { "gaze": { "command": "gaze", "args": ["-d", "2e1a:4c04", "mcp"] } } }
```

**This release**
- Linux `gaze see` / `gaze mcp` via V4L2 (MJPEG, YUYV via libjpeg)
- `just install` → `~/.local/bin/gaze`
- Asset: `gaze-linux-x86_64`

releases.name: v0.1.1 — native Qwen3-TTS (linux-amd64 CPU)
releases.body:
## qwen3-tts-native v0.1.1

First **linux-amd64 CPU** distribution tarball. Darwin Metal remains on [v0.1.0](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/qwen3-tts-native/releases/tag/v0.1.0). NVIDIA CUDA is a separate `linux-amd64-cuda` asset when that build is published.

### Assets
| File | Platform | Backend | SHA-256 |
|------|----------|---------|---------|
| `qwen3-tts-native-linux-amd64.tar.gz` | Linux x86_64 | CPU | `9655d41ec044a7be43404053746c6cd0d68fb11fb0e22b3a3723aa0265c1a1fd` |

### Layout
Schema `qwen3-tts-native.install.v1`. `install.json` uses Go's `os=linux` / `arch=amd64` so host apps that compare `runtime.GOOS`/`GOARCH` accept the archive.

- Tier: **0.6B F16** default
- Engine pin: `ed7312b8c69fcccff6285af7748fd526be2ff8cd` (`docs/ENGINE_PIN.txt`)
- Worker: `qwen3-tts-worker/v1`, 24 kHz f32le, whole-utterance PCM

### Smoke
GPD Pocket 4 (Ryzen AI 9 HX 370, no NVIDIA): worker ready, 57045 samples (~2.38 s) in 7.97 s elapsed. CPU is slower than realtime here; Kokoro remains the product default for conversation. Use this package for `models ensure --tts` on linux/amd64.

### Host install
Download, verify SHA-256, unpack, run `bin/qwen3-tts-worker` with `models/`. `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` to `bin/`.

## Fixes

- Requeue a cancelled job instead of parking it in failed/ ([#571](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/camp/pull/571))
  - Requeue a cancelled job instead of leaving it in running/
  - Leave a cancelled job for reclaim instead of parking it in failed/

  - Record the hop surviving a MagicDNS outage
  - Regenerate CLI reference for the diagnose fallback

  - Build the live-overwrite victim instead of copying /bin/sleep, and compare against an identically signed copy

## What this release does for you

- Large files stay out of git automatically; camp declares an artifact root and tells you. Off: `commit.guards.large_files: off`
- Bulk directories (node_modules-shaped) stop the commit and ask. Off: `commit.guards.bulk: off`
- camp's bookkeeping commits and `-aw` message writing run in the background. Off: `CAMP_NO_DEFER=1`
- `camp commit --json` for scripts and agents
- `camp doctor` finds large files nothing owns (`-c bigfiles`) and validates artifact roots (`-c artifacts`)
- Each commit records what your artifact roots held (committed per-machine manifests), so drift is visible in `camp doctor` without git ever storing the files

- fest commit inherits all of the above through camp commitkit, emits pure JSON with --json, and gains its own --commit-large (ships in fest v0.5.0-rc.2)

## Festival v0.2.8

Festival Methodology CLI suite release.

This release installs:
- `fest` v0.4.3 ([release](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/fest/releases/tag/v0.4.3))
- `camp` v0.2.9 ([release](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/camp/releases/tag/v0.2.9))

This release also ships Festival distribution, plugin, shell, and documentation updates from the `festival` repo itself.

## Festival Changes

### Highlights

- Hardened the Festival Claude Code plugin for public launch ([#63](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/festival/pull/63)).
- Added the repo-root Claude plugin marketplace manifest and locked plugin/marketplace version consistency.
- Added the plugin validation gate to `just test all`, including frontmatter checks, hook reference containment, manifest consistency, sync checks, and install-hook smoke coverage.
- Tightened plugin frontmatter validation so malformed quoted scalars and unsupported flow collection values fail the local gate.
- Added `claude-plugin/README.md` and audited all plugin skill trigger descriptions.
- Improved Festival shell setup and shell completions ([#62](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/festival/pull/62)).
- Refreshed bundled CLI reference docs for `fest` v0.4.3 and `camp` v0.2.9 ([#64](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/festival/pull/64)).

- improve festival shell setup by @lancekrogers in https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/festival/pull/62
- Harden Festival Claude Code plugin for public launch (FP0005) by @lancekrogers in https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/festival/pull/63
- Refresh bundled CLI docs for Festival v0.2.8 by @lancekrogers in https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/festival/pull/64
